title: Add GitHub Actions CI (npm test, commitlint on PRs) and a TypeScript Semantic Release workflow adapted from Chatticus

comments.author: home
comments.text: CI (specs, commitlint, typecheck, runner-linux on real amd64) and the Semantic Release workflow are merged (PR #8) and passing on GitHub. The first release still needs the baseline tag v0.0.0 and a develop-to-main promotion; GitHub Actions deploy is not set up yet.

right_now_summary: CI and semantic release pass, but the first release needs the v0.0.0 tag and a develop-to-main promotion.
